## What we adopt
Sortable data table with search, status badges and per-row actions (same pattern as teacher-assessment-list).

## What Ad Astra changes
One row per student: PC name, question, time left, submissions, flags; actions: extend time, unlock re-entry, message.

Ad Astra branding (plan §1.1) always overrides template colours and logos.
